genomes.name: Quiet MACD Trend
genomes.thesis: Long while the MACD histogram is positive, the index is above its 50-day mean and 20-day volatility is under 25%. Out when the histogram turns negative after at least three sessions, or after ten sessions.

entry_rules.when: macd_hist > 0 and close > sma50 and vol20 < 0.25

genomes.rationale: Written by Claude as a seed for the second calm-trend island; scored exactly as written.
